dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Come in, Nam. Let's talk about your progress.
dialogue.reading: ˈkʌm ˈɪn, ˈnɑːm. ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈprɑːɡrɛs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How long have you studied English?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv juː ˈstʌdid ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Since I was eight. So, for about twelve years.
dialogue.reading: sɪns aɪ wʌz ˈeɪt. soʊ, fər əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛlv ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Your English has improved a lot this year. Your level is much higher now.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ hæz ɪmˈpruːvd ə ˈlɑːt ðɪs ˈjɪr. jʊr ˈlɛvəl ɪz ˈmʌtʃ ˈhaɪər ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! But I'm not fluent yet. I get nervous when I talk to native speakers.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! bʌt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈfluːənt ˈjɛt. aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈnɜːrvəs wɛn aɪ ˈtɔːk tə ˈneɪtɪv ˈspiːkərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Many students feel that way. How long have you known Emma?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛni ˈstuːdənts ˈfiːl ðæt ˈweɪ. ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv juː ˈnoʊn ˈɛmə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Since my first year at university. We speak English together every day.
dialogue.reading: sɪns maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈjɪr ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti. wiː ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ təˈɡɛðər ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. That's why your speaking has improved so much.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ðæts ˈwaɪ jʊr ˈspiːkɪŋ hæz ɪmˈpruːvd ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I hope I can improve more this year.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈhoʊp aɪ kən ɪmˈpruːv ˈmɔːr ðɪs ˈjɪr.
